section.title: Credits
section.description: Your AI credit and video call minute balance, extra packs and automatic top-up.
balance.ai.title: AI credits
balance.ai.hint: When credits run out, AI replies stop and conversations are handed to your team.
balance.ai.empty: You are out of credits. AI replies have stopped and new conversations go to your team.
balance.ai.low: Balance is below your alert level ({{threshold}}).
balance.video.title: Video call minutes
balance.video.hint: Video calls use one minute per participant per minute.
balance.try.title: TRY balance
balance.try.hint: Can be applied to your invoices.
buy.title: Buy credits
buy.description: Buy an extra pack when your plan's monthly allowance is not enough. VAT is added to the prices.
buy.empty: There are no credit packs available for your plan.
buy.empty_hint: If you need more credits, contact our support team.
buy.read_only: You need billing management permission to buy credits.
buy.confirm_description: An invoice is created for this pack and you continue to payment. The credits are added to your account once your payment is confirmed.
buy.failed: This pack cannot be bought right now. Please try again shortly.
buy.pending: The credits are added to your account once your payment is confirmed. You can also pay the open invoice from the Invoices section below.
buy.pay_note: The credits are added to your account once your payment is confirmed.
settings.title: Automatic top-up and alerts
settings.description: Get notified when your balance runs low, or renew a pack automatically.
settings.alert.title: Low balance alert
settings.alert.hint: When AI credits drop below this level, owners and admins get an e-mail and in-app notification at most once a day.
settings.alert.recommended_hint: A fifth of your plan's monthly AI credits
settings.alert.recommended_value: A fifth of your plan's monthly AI credits ({{value}} credits)
settings.topup.title: Automatic top-up
settings.topup.hint: When the balance drops below your level, the selected pack is bought automatically with your saved card.
settings.topup.unavailable: Automatic top-up needs automatic payment with a saved card. You can save your card and allow automatic payment when you pay an invoice by card.
settings.topup.no_packages: There is no pack available for automatic top-up.
settings.topup.threshold: Top up when the balance drops below
settings.topup.consent: I authorize charging the price of the selected pack to my saved card automatically when the balance drops below this level.
settings.invalid_number: Enter a whole number of zero or more.
settings.conflict: Automatic top-up could not be turned on: automatic payment with a saved card is off, or the selected pack is no longer sold.
settings.failed: Settings could not be saved. Please try again.
settings.read_only: You need billing management permission to change these settings.
ledger.title: Credit activity
ledger.description: Every addition to and deduction from your balance.
pay.card_unavailable: Card payment is not available right now. You can pay by bank transfer and upload your receipt.
pay.card_failed: The payment page could not be opened. Please try again.
pay.not_ready: Payments are not set up yet; our platform team will contact you.
pay.invoice_stays_open: Your invoice stays open; you can pay it from the Invoices section once payments are ready.
